description: This file defines the StructuredReference class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for parsing and handling structured references to tables in spreadsheet formulas, including resolving cell ranges based on table structure and reference types.

classes.name: StructuredReference
classes.description: A class that parses and manages structured references to tables within spreadsheet formulas, resolving cell ranges, handling table metadata, and supporting different reference types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StructuredReference object with a given structured reference string.

methods.name: fromParser
methods.description: Creates an instance of StructuredReference from a formula string and matches, handling nested brackets.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the structured reference in context of a given cell to resolve to a cell range, fetching table structure as needed.

methods.name: isRowReference
methods.description: Determines if the reference is a row-based reference (e.g., @) rather than a column.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.description: Extracts table information such as name, range, and headers based on the reference string and table collection.

methods.name: getTableForCell
methods.description: Finds the table that contains the specified cell, if no table name is explicitly provided.

methods.name: getTableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a table object by name within the worksheet.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Gathers column labels or headers from the table to assist in reference resolution.

methods.name: getRowReference
methods.description: Generates a row-specific reference, modifying references to point to the correct row based on context.

methods.name: adjustRowReference
methods.description: Adjusts a row reference based on the actual row of a given cell and column headers.

methods.name: getColumnReference
methods.description: Computes the column range part of the reference, considering headers and total rows.

methods.name: validateParsedReference
methods.description: Validates the reference string against acceptable cell reference patterns.

methods.name: fullData
methods.description: Constructs a range string covering all data or header rows for columns.

methods.name: getMinimumRow
methods.description: Determines the minimal row number based on the reference type.

methods.name: getMaximumRow
methods.description: Determines the maximal row number based on the reference type.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the original structural reference string.

methods.name: getRowsForColumnReference
methods.description: Determines the start and end rows for column referencing, considering special item specifiers.

methods.name: getColumnsForColumnReference
methods.description: Replaces column headers with cell references in the reference string.
